verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Lord, we are
Poor in spirit
Oh, Lord lead us to mourn
Our iniquities

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Lord, we are
Lowly in heart
Oh Lord, teach us to hunger
For righteousness

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Blessed are the poor in spirit
Blessed are those who mourn
Blessed are the lowly in heart
Blessed are those who hunger

verse.name: c2
verse.lines:
For theirs is the kingdom of heaven
For they shall be comforted in Him
For they shall inherit the earth
For they shall be satisfied in You

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Lord, we believe
That we will be satisfied in You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Lord, we are poor in spirit
Oh, Lord lead us to mourn our iniquities
Lord, we are lowly in heart
Oh Lord, teach us to hunger for righteousness
